description: Spearheaded all company-wide prospecting, marketing and closing endeavors.
Brought on NASA and Southwest Airlines as clients.
Develop maximum sales potential out of major airline customers with excellent customer service techniques and knowledge of products and services, as well as competition's strengths and weaknesses.
Evaluate and calculate prices, discounts and proposals to meet specific customer requirements in an efficient manner.
Processed customer quotes and verified accurate customer and product information.
Managed submitted requests for quotes and initiated the quoting process to cultivate new business.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents as a charismatic leader with a strong background in customer support and management. Their experience spans across various airlines, demonstrating a deep understanding of client relations and negotiation skills essential for both business development and strategic partnerships.
